name: design-skills
description: Skills (design-feature, bootstrap-design-system) that orchestrate the full feature workflow from idea-mockup through implementation parity. Composes the superpowers plugin (brainstorming, writing-plans, subagent-driven-development) and Anthropic's frontend-design plugin; if either is not installed it is fetched into a per-user cache at skill start (no pre-install required). Soft-depends on a connected Markup online instance and Chrome MCP.
